items.stem: Which module links Production control to the information needed to manufacture a finished item?

options.text: Product information management, inventory and warehouse management working together
options.rationale: Correct: production control integrates with product information, inventory, general ledger and warehouse modules.
The general ledger records costs but does not supply BOM and inventory data alone.
Transportation handles freight, not the full production information flow.
Forms is a survey tool unrelated to production control.

items.explanation: Correct: production control integrates with product information, inventory, general ledger and warehouse modules.

items.stem: Which TWO are part of the procurement and sourcing area in Supply Chain Management? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: purchase order creation is a core procurement task.
Correct: purchasing policies and approval workflows are configured in procurement and sourcing.
Collection letters are an accounts-receivable activity.

items.stem: When must a purchase order be used instead of only a purchase invoice?

options.text: When the process must record partial receipts of an order quantity
options.rationale: Correct: purchase orders support partial receipts and drop shipments; a standalone invoice does not.

options.text: When no inventory is involved at all
options.rationale: Service-only purchases can still use invoices without an order.

options.text: Only when paying in a foreign currency
options.rationale: Currency does not determine whether an order is required.
Partial-receipt handling, not intercompany scope, drives the need for an order.

items.explanation: Correct: purchase orders support partial receipts and drop shipments; a standalone invoice does not.
